The Subtask Name: Identify FuboTV's IPO Year

The Oracle: 2020
Evidence: WebServing_Expert searches for "FuboTV IPO year" and confirms the IPO occurred in October 2020.

The Subtask Name: Identify FuboTV Management Team Members

The Subtask Name: Determine Joining Years of Management Team

The Oracle: David Gandler (2020), Alberto Horihuela Suarez (2016), John Janedis (2020), Sung Choi (Unknown)
